# Brian Peery, West Las Vegas Real Estate

> Brian Peery is a Nevada real estate salesperson (NV Lic. S.189680) with Realty ONE Group Summerlin, 10750 W. Charleston Blvd., Ste 180, Las Vegas, NV 89135. He helps people buy and sell homes in guard-gated and gated golf and trail communities in Summerlin and west Las Vegas, and helps investors line up replacement property for 1031 exchanges.

Background: 30 years in the markets, 16 as a portfolio manager at Hennessy Advisors, and 30+ years investing in and managing property, now helping people buy and sell homes in gated golf and trail communities in west Las Vegas.

Contact: call or text (415) 999-1044, email brian@bpeery.com, or book a 15-minute call at https://bpeery.com/contact. Each Realty ONE Group office is independently owned and operated.

## Communities

- [Red Rock Country Club (89135)](https://bpeery.com/red-rock-country-club): A guard-gated club community in Summerlin built around two Arnold Palmer signature golf courses, with Red Rock Canyon just to the west.
- [The Summit Club (89135)](https://bpeery.com/the-summit-club): A small, guard-gated luxury community in Summerlin with a private 18-hole course designed by Tom Fazio.
- [The Ridges (89135)](https://bpeery.com/the-ridges): A guard-gated Summerlin community known for custom homes on view lots, minutes from Downtown Summerlin and Red Rock Canyon.
- [Regency at The Cliffs (89148)](https://bpeery.com/the-cliffs): The guard-gated neighborhood of Summerlin’s Cliffs village: Regency by Toll Brothers, an age-qualified (55 and older) community of about 430 homes near Hualapai Way and the 215.
- [Siena (89135)](https://bpeery.com/siena): A guard-gated, age-restricted (55 and older) community in Summerlin, built around Siena Golf Club.
- [Canyon Gate Country Club (89117)](https://bpeery.com/canyon-gate): A guard-gated golf community at Sahara Avenue and Buffalo Drive, built around a private 18-hole Ted Robinson course.
- [Tournament Hills (89134)](https://bpeery.com/tournament-hills): A guard-gated community in The Hills village of Summerlin, set along the private TPC Summerlin course, longtime home of the PGA Tour’s Las Vegas stop.
- [The Canyons (89144)](https://bpeery.com/the-canyons): Gated Summerlin neighborhoods around TPC Las Vegas, several of them guard-gated, with the canyon washes and trails running between them.

- [All communities](https://bpeery.com/communities): Guide to guard-gated and gated golf and trail communities in west Las Vegas: Red Rock Country Club, The Summit Club, The Ridges, Regency at The Cliffs, Siena, Canyon Gate, Tournament Hills and The Canyons.

## Golf

- [Golf on the west side](https://bpeery.com/golf): every course in 89135 and 89117 split into private clubs and public tee times, the public courses within about 45 minutes (Brian's favorite public course is Las Vegas Paiute Golf Resort), and the private clubs within about 45 minutes.

## Tools and guides

- [Calculators](https://bpeery.com/tools): Median prices, HOA dues and facts for eight gated golf and trail communities in west Las Vegas, plus payment, affordability and seller net-proceeds calculators.
- [1031 exchanges](https://bpeery.com/1031): How a 1031 exchange works, a 45-day and 180-day deadline calculator, and help finding replacement property in Las Vegas, including commercial property when an exchange calls for it.
